item_name: Rothco Vintage Carry-On Travel Bag - Olive Drab
item_short_desc: Our Vintage Carry-On Travel Bag features an airport friendly design that allows you to comfortably place it underneath an airplane seat. Measuring 16 inch x 14.5 inch x 8 inch, the weekender bag classifies as a carry on or personal item for air travel while offering plenty of storage space for 2-3 day’s worth of clothes, an extra pair of shoes, toiletries, and other travel essentials.
description: Our Vintage Carry-On Travel Bag features an airport friendly design that allows you to comfortably place it underneath an airplane seat. Measuring 16 inch x 14.5 inch x 8 inch, the weekender bag classifies as a carry on or personal item for air travel while offering plenty of storage space for 2-3 day’s worth of clothes, an extra pair of shoes, toiletries, and other travel essentials. Top Grade Canvas: Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. These travel duffle bags are made of 100% cotton canvas that is reinforced with double-stitched seams, ensuring that your gear stays protected as you travel. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of premium canvas bags and packs. Utility at the Forefront: The personal item bag features a trolley sleeve that allows you to securely attach it to a suitcase, ensuring all your luggage stays with you. In addition to the top access zipper pocket, the luggage sleeve has another zipper on the bottom that converts it into another pocket. The hard insert bottom and four brass pegs enhance the carry-on bag’s structure and stability while keeping it off the ground. When wearing as a crossbody bag, the side “claw” clips offer space to store additional accessories, and when the shoulder strap is disconnected, they clip into the d-rings for a compact design. 3-Way Carry: These weekend travel bags come equipped with ergonomic top grab handles for quick and easy handling. The adjustable shoulder strap extends up to 55 inches, giving you the option to wear it as a crossbody bag where your travel essentials are kept close to you for added security. The shoulder strap is also detachable and can be conveniently stored away when not in use. Exquisite Details & Functionality: Furnished with genuine buffalo leather accents, antiqued brass hardware, and grey denim lining, travel in style and confidence with this flight friendly travel bag. The main compartment features a two-way zipper for quick and easy access. Additionally, keep loose or smaller items organized and tucked away within the inner zipper pocket and two storage pockets.
